title: Isotopes n.e.c. and compounds thereof (including heavy water)

review.classification: The frozen 34260 coordinate, the UNSD link to heading 2845 and the definition in HS chapter 28 note 6 support intentionally labelled carbon-13 calcium carbonate under HS 2845.90. The eligibility evidence separates the actual finished powder from generic organic laboratory preparations, calcite mineral, natural-range isotope standards and ordinary unlabelled carbonate.
review.primary_evidence: The Naviaux et al. 2019 primary paper identifies an actual purchase of catalogue 492027. The same supplier’s original catalogue explicitly allows packing from bulk. Its March 2016 quality policy identifies a contemporaneous release event and distinguishes a later retest. None of those records identifies the first eligible lot, upstream release history or measured net mass for a study.
review.native_records: Two exact-version TianGong public reads identify an ordinary carbonate product associated with 34240 and a calcite mineral associated with 16190. Both must be excluded as the labelled reference product. Original ILCD property/unit records are independent of any later product-flow selection.

review.readiness: Candidate/authored methodology. Product-flow identity, matched original lot, genuine first release, upstream environmental coverage and actual packaging and service records remain study-specific. Mapping acceptance does not complete scientific review, independent translation review or publication.
review.measurement: Independently exercised both physical ledgers in kg. Unreleased opening 0 plus fresh receipt 12 equals original release 8 plus retained stock 2, externally submitted sample 1 and separately discarded powder 1. Released opening 4 plus the same original release 8, genuine return 2 and unrelated already-released receipt 3 equals closing 10 plus outward dispatch 6 and a separate external sample 1. Q cancels on consolidation and remains 8 despite those movements. A same-site retained sample remains in closing stock. Subsequent services in a zero-current-Q period retain original exchange units until a verified positive original cohort denominator is available. Separately close component custody and original burden by lot and period. Whole chemical net mass, isotope atom fraction and chemical purity are three separate measurements. The controller linked the calculation rows to the author’s specific sample, released-stock and subsequent-service protocols in both languages.

sources.first_title_line: Isotopes n.e.c. and compounds thereof (including heavy water)

sources.role: UNSD October original, CPC3 sheet row 1429. The reviewed frozen leaf 34260 corresponds to HS heading 2845. No assumed site inventory.

Naviaux et al., Geochimica et Cosmochimica Acta 246 (2019), Methods, confirmed actual purchased labelled calcium carbonate powder, SKU 492027, in primary geochemistry research. The study-specific unit, downstream experiments and third-party batches do not define a first manufacturer release or the lot-specific cradle inventory.

Original finished labelled product and lot-specific certificate lookup; the packaging section admits on-demand packaging from bulk. A finished bulk lot, its first documented product release and subsequent physical subdivisions have different event ledgers.
Heading 28.45, note 6 final paragraph, and 2845.90 corroborate limited non-radioactive intentionally labelled compound. Ordinary mineral and natural isotopic variation are distinct.

Original supplier policy of March 9, 2016, p. 1. The supplier documents analytical quality review by product/lot, separately from later extensions or retest certificates. Historic supplier-wide practice and the separately attested purchase of SKU 492027 make a first-quality-release gate credible. Check a specific original lot, prior upstream quality status, dates, net product mass and applicable policy independently.
IAEA reference carbonate illustrates natural-range isotope calibration. Reference-material status is insufficient for a deliberately labelled finished compound.
Commission Recommendation (EU) 2021/2279, Annex I: separate reference unit, physical boundary, allocation and packaging treatment. The stock accounts in this PCR are method-specific.
